definition: Speech Processing Solutions is an international electronics company headquartered in Vienna, Austria.
details: The company designs, develops, manufactures and markets speech processing devices, such as those used in digital dictation and speech recognition. Speech Processing Solutions was formed on 1 July 2012. Philips Speech Processing was part of the Philips Consumer Lifestyle sector. Speech Processing Solutions is now an official licensee of the Philips brand. The company has subsidiaries in the US, Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom, Belgium, France and Germany, and employs around 170 people worldwide.

explainer.lead: Speech Processing Solutions is an electronics company based in Vienna that makes speech processing devices for digital dictation and speech recognition. It matters as the current holder of the Philips speech processing business, operating under licence of the Philips brand.

tiers.eli5: It's a company in Austria that builds the gadgets and software people talk into to turn their speech into written text.
tiers.practitioner: Organisations buying dictation or speech recognition hardware may encounter it as the official Philips-brand licensee. Note that it is a company, not a technique, so it has no place in a model or pipeline design.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition exists; it is a corporate entity founded on 1 July 2012 from Philips Speech Processing, formerly part of the Philips Consumer Lifestyle sector. It holds a Philips brand licence and has subsidiaries in the US, Canada, Australia, the UK, Belgium, France and Germany, employing around 170 people.

explainer.example: A hospital procuring Philips-branded digital dictation devices is buying them from Speech Processing Solutions, the licensed manufacturer.
